name: rfq-insight
description: Analyse an RFQ package folder and generate the AVL RFQ Insight PowerPoint deck with evidence-checked findings.

interface.shortDescription: Analyse RFQs and build evidence-backed decks
interface.longDescription: Point RFQ Insight at the folder holding an RFQ package (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, CSV and images) and it answers the twelve fixed RFQ Insight sections, scores each section's confidence out of 10, verifies its own claims in an isolated pass and writes the AVL-branded PowerPoint deck to the folder's output directory.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $rfq-insight to analyse the RFQ package in this folder and return only the PowerPoint.
